definitions.uniform: Equal valid candidates within each query, then same query weighting. Candidate-vote fractions separately weight queries by candidate_count.
definitions.source_mass_quality: Per-source sum(project_mass*project_quality), before per-satellite-target normalization; not actual normalized downstream contribution.
definitions.entropy_normalized: Mean per-head H/log(candidate_count), count1=0. entropy_headmean_distribution is separate entropy of head-mean distribution.
definitions.view_dominance_headmean: Largest five-view mass after averaging candidate weights over heads.
definitions.invalidheight: Reference height invalid; offsets/masses only describe model coordinate inputs, not reliable physical height truth.
definitions.quantiles: Unweighted linear interpolation; weighted discrete inverse-CDF with stable sort.

interpretation_limits: Descriptive fixed six current EMA images. Attention compatibility is geometric consistency, not semantic correctness or utility. Rows without any candidate are excluded from all quality summaries; no comparison to E72 raw training .508. No GT, fit, intervention, AP, success gate or causal mechanism claim.
